references.text: Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it shall eat its fruit.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable to you, Lord, my rock and my redeemer.
For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may receive what is due for what he has done in the body, whether good or evil.
For we all stumble in many ways. If anyone does not stumble in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to bridle his whole body.
If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us. If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
